contradictions.description: EntityDescription_WriteClientData calls MethodDescription_Destructor (0x015942f0) with a stream pointer as second argument. The function at 0x015942f0 is named 'Destructor' but appears to accept a stream and write method data to it. This name may be wrong — it could be MethodDescription_WriteToStream. W0 should investigate 0x015942f0 xrefs.

Two DataDescription layouts confirmed: 0x40 bytes (runtime, stored in EntityDescription property arrays after parse) and 0x110 bytes (parse-time form in DataDescriptionVec_Insert/Resize). The 0x40 form is used in EntityDescription_WriteClientData and GetClientPropertyByIndex.

RESOLVED: DataDescription_Destructor (0x01591b00) IS a destructor — confirmed by scalable_free on +0x70 pointer when non-null, and string heap free pattern (if capacity > 0xf, free ptr at +0x04). The function at 0x015942f0 used in EntityDescription_WriteClientData (0x01590fc0) is a DIFFERENT function — that one takes a stream as its second arg and is NOT a destructor. The name MethodDescription_Destructor at 0x015942f0 is likely wrong and should be renamed MethodDescription_WriteToStream.
